meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 对代码库做技术债务审计，覆盖9个维度：架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档。用AST-grep、grep等工具搜索，可选CodeGraph知识图谱。产出TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md，含严重性、工作量估计、优先级修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求代码健康检查、技术债务审计、架构评审或代码质量评估时触发。触发词如“tech debt”、“code health”、“audit code quality”等。

say.text: 审计这个项目的技术债务，生成报告
检查代码库健康度，找出最严重问题
分析架构中的循环依赖和死代码

howto.what_en: Audits codebase technical debt across 9 dimensions using AST-grep, grep, native tools, optionally CodeGraph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks for code health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, or code quality assessment, or mentions triggers like 'tech debt', 'code health', 'audit code quality' etc.

say_en.text: Audit this project's technical debt and generate a report.
Check codebase health and list the most severe issues.
Analyze architecture for circular dependencies and dead code.
